en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a straight, old street bordered by large wooden and brick buildings, with wooden stairs and large windows. There are some people visible in the distance, and the street appears unpaved, muddy, and lined with utility poles. The printed text at the top left is in red and includes multiple names for the location in different languages.
